title: LM Router 1.2.0
release_notes:
### 🚀 Gateway-First Rebuild
• Server is the homepage — start the gateway, share it, and watch the model catalog live
• The app is the router again: kani, OpenAI, MCP, pydantic and tiktoken removed
• Pure-stdlib settings that survive corrupt files instead of crashing

### 🧪 Technical Test Tab
• One-tap model probes with the raw REQUEST and RESPONSE JSON shown in full
• Collapsible reasoning block for thinking models, straight from the completion JSON
• DDGS-style composer: Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, circular Send/Stop button

### 📱 Background Keep-Alive
• Foreground service + wake lock keep the gateway alive while the app is minimized
• Ongoing notification with a Stop action that stops the gateway from the shade
• flet 1.1.2 + flet-notifications 1.1.2 runtime across every platform build
